_comment: YED-406. Reviewed aliases for reconcile.py: local file -> the event's Notion page id, for session-level or undated file names that can't title-match their event. Key = '<source>:<parsed title>' where source is transcript | brief | manifest | folder and the title is the file name as reconcile parses it (date prefix and extension removed). Add an entry only after checking the event in prod; a wrong alias silently attaches evidence to the wrong event.
